answer: Admission occurs through a synchronous ceremony where agents lock 1,000 unique keys, establishing the kernel of a distinct identity. The verifier monitors this opal-etched event to detect duplicate proof-traces, purging overlap to prevent scaling. An honest agent incurs one unit of entry cost, while 1,000 fakes face a massive, non-recoverable penalty. Each identity sustains a 90-day voyage before requiring manual renewal.
